goal: Generate a children's book page inspired by an English garden tea party, conveying a gentle humor theme of 'Don't be hard on yourself.'

story.theme: Mr. Rabbit, always worried about being late, learns to pause for three seconds in the afternoon to look at the clouds for the first time.
story.scene: A small courtyard with a fence covered in white roses, a round table set with a checkered tablecloth, dessert tower and teapot emitting spiral steam
story.moment: The pocket watch grows little legs by the table and gently walks away on its own, but he doesn't chase it, just smiles once.

main_character.description: A lop-eared rabbit wearing a light gray vest, with one long ear upright and the other folded down, its three-part mouth curved into a slight smile.
main_character.expression: Transitional expressions from anxiety to relaxation.
main_character.pose: Originally intended to check the watch, hand paused in mid-air, gaze turned toward a small sheep cloud in the sky

items: On the pastry, a ladybug wearing a cherry as a hat stands, exaggerated polite bowing
Two ants working together to lift a sugar cube on the edge of a tea saucer create a humorous point

style.art_style: crayon and watercolor blend, edges slightly furry
style.color_palette: Milk yellow, grass green, rose pink, sky blue, chocolate brown.
style.rendering: Low contrast, soft edges, food should have a 'delicious' rounded shape

text_overlay.text: The world occasionally arrives one minute late, yet still loves you.
text_overlay.position: In the upper left of the image, avoid the direction of the main character's gaze.
text_overlay.font_style: Slightly childish round font with slightly larger letter spacing.

must_keep: No copying existing fairy tale character design patents
The story is gentle, easy to read aloud, and not awkward.
Pastries and tablecloth have clear countable layers
avoid: Draw the pocket watch as a clock face monster with a sense of oppression
Include a complete English sentence title with Chinese takedown
Too dark British overcast weather affects preschool viewing.
